exposure: Elective B-Lynch suture during emergency caesarean section
cohort: Forty antenatal women undergoing emergency caesarean section with risk factors for atony of the uterus were included in the study.
finding: Elective B-Lynch suture is effective, quick, and cheap in preventing atonic Postpartum Haemorrhage in women undergoing emergency lower segment caesarian section who are at high risk for haemorrhage.
mod_finding: Elective B-Lynch suture applied during emergency lower segment caesarean section is effective in preventing atonic postpartum haemorrhage.
